census_geography_2024 <- readr::read_csv("../data/raw/census_geography_2024.csv")

## Clean each source

### Source 1
```{r}
fbs_rosters_raw = readr::read_csv("../data/raw/fbs_rosters.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ============================================================================
# Lookup tables
# ============================================================================

# ---- Positions: every abbreviation / variant -> one spelled-out name --------
# Keys are UPPERCASE. Alternate names for the same position are merged
# (OL / Offensive Line / Offensive Linemen -> "Offensive Lineman"), but distinct
# positions stay distinct (Defensive End vs. Defensive Lineman, etc.).
position_lookup = c(
  # Offense
  "QB" = "Quarterback",            "QUARTERBACK" = "Quarterback",
  "RB" = "Running Back",           "RUNNING BACK" = "Running Back",
  "FB" = "Fullback",               "FULLBACK" = "Fullback",
  "SB" = "Slotback",
  "ATH" = "Athlete",
  "WR" = "Wide Receiver",          "WIDE RECEIVER" = "Wide Receiver", "WIDE RECIEVER" = "Wide Receiver",
  "SLOT" = "Slot Receiver",
  "TE" = "Tight End",              "TIGHT END" = "Tight End",
  "OL" = "Offensive Lineman",      "OFFENSIVE LINE" = "Offensive Lineman",
  "OFFENSIVE LINEMAN" = "Offensive Lineman", "OFFENSIVE LINEMEN" = "Offensive Lineman",
  "INTERIOR OFFENSIVE LINE" = "Interior Offensive Lineman",
  "OT" = "Offensive Tackle",       "OFFENSIVE TACKLE" = "Offensive Tackle",
  "OG" = "Offensive Guard",
  "C" = "Center",                  "OC" = "Center",
  # Defense
  "DL" = "Defensive Lineman",      "DEFENSIVE LINE" = "Defensive Lineman",
  "DEFENSIVE LINEMAN" = "Defensive Lineman", "DEFENSIVE LINEMEN" = "Defensive Lineman",
  "DE" = "Defensive End",          "DEFENSIVE END" = "Defensive End",
  "E" = "End",
  "DT" = "Defensive Tackle",       "DEFENSIVE TACKLE" = "Defensive Tackle",
  "NT" = "Nose Tackle",            "NG" = "Nose Tackle",            "NOSE" = "Nose Tackle",
  "EDGE" = "Edge Rusher",          "ER" = "Edge Rusher",            "RUSH" = "Edge Rusher",
  "J" = "Jack",                    "JACK" = "Jack",                 "JK" = "Jack",
  "BAN" = "Bandit",                "BANDIT" = "Bandit",
  "LB" = "Linebacker",             "LINEBACKER" = "Linebacker",
  "OLB" = "Outside Linebacker",    "OUTSIDE LINEBACKER" = "Outside Linebacker",
  "ILB" = "Inside Linebacker",     "INSIDE LINEBACKER" = "Inside Linebacker",
  "MB" = "Money Backer",           "MONEY BACKER" = "Money Backer",
  "DB" = "Defensive Back",         "DEFENSIVE BACK" = "Defensive Back",
  "CB" = "Cornerback",             "CORNERBACK" = "Cornerback",
  "S" = "Safety",                  "SAF" = "Safety",                "SAFETY" = "Safety",
  "NB" = "Nickelback",             "N" = "Nickelback",              "NI" = "Nickelback",
  "NIC" = "Nickelback",            "NICK" = "Nickelback",           "NK" = "Nickelback",
  "NKL" = "Nickelback",
  "STAR" = "Star",
  "SPR" = "Spur",                  "SPUR" = "Spur",
  "VIPER" = "Viper",
  # Special teams
  "K" = "Kicker",                  "KICKER" = "Kicker",             "PK" = "Kicker",
  "PLACEKICKER" = "Kicker",        "PLACE KICKER" = "Kicker",
  "P" = "Punter",                  "PUNTER" = "Punter",
  "LS" = "Long Snapper",           "LONG SNAPPER" = "Long Snapper", "LONGSNAPPER" = "Long Snapper",
  "SN" = "Long Snapper",           "SNP" = "Long Snapper",          "DS" = "Long Snapper",
  "DEEP SNAPPER" = "Long Snapper"
)

# ---- US states / DC / territories -> postal code -----------------------------
# Keys are lowercase letters only ("N.C." -> "nc", "W. Va." -> "wva", "O'ahu" -> "oahu")
state_key = function(x) stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_remove_all(stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII"), "[^a-zA-Z]"))

us_lookup = c(
  setNames(c(state.abb, "DC"), state_key(c(state.name, "District of Columbia"))),   # full names
  setNames(c(state.abb, "DC"), stringr::str_to_lower(c(state.abb, "DC"))),         # postal codes
  # AP-style and other abbreviations found in the data
  "ala" = "AL", "ariz" = "AZ", "ark" = "AR", "cal" = "CA", "cali" = "CA", "calif" = "CA",
  "colo" = "CO", "conn" = "CT", "del" = "DE", "fla" = "FL", "ill" = "IL", "ind" = "IN",
  "kan" = "KS", "kans" = "KS", "mass" = "MA", "mich" = "MI", "minn" = "MN", "miss" = "MS",
  "mis" = "MO",                                     # only occurrence: Saint Peters, Mo.
  "mont" = "MT", "neb" = "NE", "nev" = "NV", "okla" = "OK", "ore" = "OR", "penn" = "PA",
  "tenn" = "TN", "tex" = "TX", "texa" = "TX", "wash" = "WA", "wis" = "WI", "wisc" = "WI",
  "wva" = "WV", "wyo" = "WY", "washingtondc" = "DC",
  "oahu" = "HI", "maui" = "HI",                     # Hawaiian islands listed instead of state
  "americansamoa" = "AS", "americansamoatuala" = "AS", "northernmarianaislands" = "MP"
)

# ---- Non-US provinces/states -> full name and country ------------------------
province_lookup = tibble::tribble(
  ~key,               ~province,           ~country,
  "ontario",          "Ontario",           "Canada",
  "ont",              "Ontario",           "Canada",
  "quebec",           "Quebec",            "Canada",
  "alberta",          "Alberta",           "Canada",
  "britishcolumbia",  "British Columbia",  "Canada",
  "bc",               "British Columbia",  "Canada",
  "manitoba",         "Manitoba",          "Canada",
  "novascotia",       "Nova Scotia",       "Canada",
  "victoria",         "Victoria",          "Australia",
  "vic",              "Victoria",          "Australia",
  "southaustralia",   "South Australia",   "Australia",
  "westernaustralia", "Western Australia", "Australia",
  "queensland",       "Queensland",        "Australia",
  "newsouthwales",    "New South Wales",   "Australia",
  "grandbahama",      "Grand Bahama",      "Bahamas",
  "savaii",           "Savai'i",           "Samoa",
  "bavaria",          "Bavaria",           "Germany"
)

# ---- Countries listed in place of a state -----------------------------------
country_lookup = c(
  "australia" = "Australia", "aus" = "Australia", "au" = "Australia", "austrailia" = "Australia",
  "germany" = "Germany", "ger" = "Germany",
  "england" = "England", "ireland" = "Ireland", "northernireland" = "Northern Ireland",
  "unitedkingdom" = "United Kingdom", "uk" = "United Kingdom",
  "canada" = "Canada", "can" = "Canada",
  "netherlands" = "Netherlands", "thenetherlands" = "Netherlands",
  "newzealand" = "New Zealand", "sweden" = "Sweden", "nigeria" = "Nigeria", "finland" = "Finland",
  "ghana" = "Ghana", "mexico" = "Mexico", "bahamas" = "Bahamas", "tonga" = "Tonga",
  "france" = "France", "italy" = "Italy", "austria" = "Austria", "spain" = "Spain",
  "brazil" = "Brazil", "senegal" = "Senegal", "haiti" = "Haiti", "denmark" = "Denmark",
  "belgium" = "Belgium", "israel" = "Israel", "serbia" = "Serbia", "china" = "China",
  "russia" = "Russia", "estonia" = "Estonia", "samoa" = "Samoa",
  "drofthecongo" = "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
  "democraticrepublicofcongo" = "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
  "democraticrepublicofthecongo" = "Democratic Republic of the Congo"
)

# ============================================================================
# Cleaning functions
# ============================================================================

# Year -> "1".."8" by eligibility year (redshirt status ignored: R-Fr. -> "1")
clean_year = function(x) {
  s = stringr::str_to_lower(x)
  from_digit = stringr::str_extract(s, "[1-8](?=st|nd|rd|th)")              # 1st, 5th, "So. (2nd)", R-6th
  from_word = dplyr::case_when(                                              # First Year, Fifth Year, ...
    stringr::str_detect(s, "first")   ~ "1", stringr::str_detect(s, "second") ~ "2",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "third")   ~ "3", stringr::str_detect(s, "fourth") ~ "4",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "fifth")   ~ "5", stringr::str_detect(s, "sixth")  ~ "6",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "seventh") ~ "7", stringr::str_detect(s, "eighth") ~ "8"
  )
  from_class = dplyr::case_when(                                             # Fr. / Sophomore / R-Jr. / Gr.
    stringr::str_detect(s, "(senior|sr\\.?)\\+")             ~ "5",          # "Senior+" = beyond 4th year
    stringr::str_detect(s, "\\b(fr|freshman|rf)\\b")         ~ "1",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "\\b(so|sophomore)\\b")           ~ "2",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "\\b(jr|junior)\\b")              ~ "3",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "\\b(sr|senior)\\b")              ~ "4",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "\\b(gr|graduate|post-bacc)\\b")  ~ "5",          # graduate students -> 5th year
    stringr::str_detect(s, "^rs\\.?$")                       ~ "1"           # bare "Rs." = redshirt freshman
  )
  dplyr::coalesce(from_digit, from_word, from_class)
}

# Position -> spelled out; multi-position values keep every position ("WR/CB" -> "Wide Receiver/Cornerback")
clean_position = function(x) {
  x = stringr::str_squish(x)
  x = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(x, "^[A-Z]+( [A-Z]+)+$"),           # "CB S" -> "CB/S"
                     stringr::str_replace_all(x, " ", "/"), x)
  purrr::map_chr(stringr::str_split(x, "\\s*/\\s*"), function(parts) {
    if (all(is.na(parts))) return(NA_character_)
    full = unname(position_lookup[stringr::str_to_upper(parts)])
    if (any(is.na(full))) return(NA_character_)                               # unmapped -> NA (reported below)
    if (setequal(full, c("Kicker", "Punter"))) return("Kicker/Punter")    # P/K, K/P, PK/P -> one label
    paste(unique(full), collapse = "/")
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# Clean
# ============================================================================
fbs_rosters_clean = fbs_rosters_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # ---- Hometown: fix the few city/state values that were split or glued wrong ----
    hometown_state = stringr::str_remove(hometown_state, "\\s*/.*$"),          # "N.J./Sayreville, N.J." -> "N.J."
    hometown_city  = dplyr::if_else(hometown_city %in% "Bowling" & hometown_state %in% "Green, Ky.",
                                    "Bowling Green", hometown_city),
    hometown_state = dplyr::if_else(hometown_state %in% "Green, Ky.", "Ky.", hometown_state),

    # City with the state glued on and no state ("Grand Rapids Mich.", "Brentwood. TN")
    glued_tok      = stringr::str_extract(hometown_city, "(?<=[.\\s])\\S+$"),
    glued          = is.na(hometown_state) & !is.na(glued_tok) & state_key(glued_tok) %in% names(us_lookup),
    hometown_state = dplyr::if_else(glued, glued_tok, hometown_state),
    hometown_city  = dplyr::if_else(glued, stringr::str_remove(hometown_city, "[.\\s]+\\S+$"), hometown_city),

    # Region/country written in the city column, or high schools listed as the city
    hometown_state = dplyr::case_when(
      hometown_city == "American Samoa" ~ "American Samoa",
      hometown_city == "Ireland"        ~ "Ireland",
      hometown_city == "Bavaria"        ~ "Bavaria",
      hometown_city == "Manitoba"       ~ "Manitoba, Canada",              # province was entered as the city
      TRUE ~ hometown_state
    ),
    hometown_city = dplyr::case_when(
      hometown_city %in% c("American Samoa", "Ireland", "Bavaria", "Manitoba") ~ NA_character_,
      stringr::str_detect(hometown_city, "(\\bHS|Institute)$")     ~ NA_character_,
      hometown_city == "Durhman"                                   ~ "Durham",
      TRUE ~ hometown_city
    ),

    # East Carolina lists only the city for North Carolina players
    hometown_state = dplyr::if_else(school == "East Carolina" & is.na(hometown_state) & !is.na(hometown_city),
                                    "N.C.", hometown_state),

    # ---- Split "Region, Country" / "Region (Country)" ----
    region_raw  = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove(hometown_state, "\\s*[,(].*$")),
    country_raw = stringr::str_match(hometown_state, "[,(]\\s*([^)]+)\\)?\\s*$")[, 2],
    region_key  = state_key(region_raw),

    us_code     = unname(us_lookup[region_key]),
    province    = province_lookup$province[match(region_key, province_lookup$key)],
    hometown_country = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(us_code)     ~ "United States",
      !is.na(country_raw) ~ unname(country_lookup[state_key(country_raw)]),
      !is.na(province)    ~ province_lookup$country[match(region_key, province_lookup$key)],
      TRUE                ~ unname(country_lookup[region_key])
    ),
    hometown_state = dplyr::coalesce(us_code, province),                       # NA when only a country is listed

    # ---- Year, position ----
    year     = clean_year(year),
    position = clean_position(position),

    # ---- Previous schools: drop leading slashes ("/ Auburn // SMU" -> "Auburn // SMU") ----
    previous_school = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove(previous_school, "^[\\s/]+"))
  ) |>
  # One previous school per column, split on "/" (any number of slashes) or ","
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
    previous_school,
    delim     = stringr::regex("\\s*/+\\s*|,\\s*"),
    names_sep = "_",                                                          # previous_school_1, _2, ...
    too_few   = "align_start"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(tidyselect::starts_with("previous_school_"), ~ dplyr::na_if(stringr::str_squish(.x), "")),

    # ---- Types: nominal -> factor, measurements -> numeric ----
    school           = factor(school),
    conference       = factor(conference),
    year             = factor(year, levels = as.character(1:8)),
    position         = factor(position),
    hometown_state   = factor(hometown_state),
    hometown_country = factor(hometown_country),
    height_in        = as.numeric(height_in),
    weight_lbs       = as.numeric(weight_lbs)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(school, conference, name, year, position, height_in, weight_lbs,
                hometown_city, hometown_state, hometown_country, tidyselect::starts_with("previous_school_"))

# ============================================================================
# Checks: anything that had a value before cleaning but NA after was not recognized
# ============================================================================
unmapped = function(before, after) sort(unique(before[!is.na(before) & is.na(after)]))
message("Unrecognized years:     ", paste(unmapped(fbs_rosters_raw$year, fbs_rosters_clean$year), collapse = " | "))
message("Unrecognized positions: ", paste(unmapped(fbs_rosters_raw$position, fbs_rosters_clean$position), collapse = " | "))
message("Unrecognized hometowns: ",
        paste(unmapped(fbs_rosters_raw$hometown_state,
                       dplyr::coalesce(as.character(fbs_rosters_clean$hometown_state),
                                       as.character(fbs_rosters_clean$hometown_country))), collapse = " | "))
```

### Source 2

```{r}
# ---- Place-name cleaning ------------------------------------------------------
# Census place names look like "Abbeville city, Alabama". The city name, the
# place type, and the state are three variables, so they are split apart.
place_types = c("city and borough", "unified government", "consolidated government",
                "metropolitan government", "metro government", "metro township", "urban county",
                "zona urbana", "comunidad", "municipality", "corporation",
                "borough", "village", "town", "city", "CDP")
consolidated_types = c("unified government", "consolidated government", "metropolitan government",
                       "metro government", "urban county")
type_pattern = paste0("\\s(", paste(place_types, collapse = "|"), ")$")

census_clean = census_geography_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # 1. Drop the state ("Abbeville city, Alabama" -> "Abbeville city"); state is already in state_abbr
    name = stringr::str_remove(name, ",\\s*[^,]+$"),

    # 2. Places only: drop county disambiguation, e.g. "Mount Olive CDP (Coosa County)" -> "Mount Olive CDP"
    name = dplyr::if_else(geography_level == "place",
                          stringr::str_remove(name, "\\s*\\((?!balance)[^)]*\\)$"), name),
    balance = geography_level == "place" & stringr::str_detect(name, "\\(balance\\)"),
    name    = stringr::str_remove(name, "\\s*\\(balance\\)$"),

    # 3. Split off the place type ("Abbeville city" -> name "Abbeville", place_type "city")
    place_type = dplyr::if_else(geography_level == "place",
                                stringr::str_match(name, type_pattern)[, 2], NA_character_),
    name = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(place_type), stringr::str_remove(name, type_pattern), name),

    # 4. Consolidated city-counties -> the city ("Louisville/Jefferson County" -> "Louisville",
    #    "Nashville-Davidson" -> "Nashville"). Real hyphenated cities (Winston-Salem) are untouched.
    consolidated = geography_level == "place" &
      (place_type %in% consolidated_types |
         (is.na(place_type) & (balance | stringr::str_detect(name, "[-/].*County$")))),
    name = dplyr::if_else(consolidated, stringr::str_remove(name, "[-/].*$"), name),

    # 5. Census writes "Legal name (common name)"; keep the common name
    #    ("San Buenaventura (Ventura)" -> "Ventura", "El Paso de Robles (Paso Robles)" -> "Paso Robles")
    name = dplyr::if_else(geography_level == "place" & stringr::str_detect(name, "\\([^)]+\\)$"),
                          stringr::str_match(name, "\\(([^)]+)\\)$")[, 2], name),

    # 6. Two large cities whose Census names differ from everyday usage
    name = dplyr::case_when(
      geography_level == "place" & name == "Urban Honolulu"                    ~ "Honolulu",
      geography_level == "place" & name == "Boise City" & state_abbr == "ID"   ~ "Boise",
      TRUE ~ stringr::str_squish(name)
    )
  )

# ---- County names: one consistent format ("Chambers County") for every row --------
# County rows now hold "Autauga County"; place rows held only "Chambers" from the boundary file.
county_names = census_clean |>
  dplyr::filter(geography_level == "county") |>
  dplyr::select(county_geoid = geoid, county_name_clean = name)

census_clean = census_clean |>
  dplyr::left_join(county_names, by = "county_geoid") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    county_name = county_name_clean,

    # ---- Values that are technically incorrect as reported ----
    # ACS codes medians outside its published range as 2,499 (= "under $2,500") and
    # 250,001 (= "over $250,000"). Keep the boundary value and flag it.
    median_income_censored = dplyr::case_when(
      median_income == 2499   ~ "Bottom-coded (under $2,500)",
      median_income == 250001 ~ "Top-coded (over $250,000)"
    ),
    median_income = dplyr::case_when(
      median_income == 2499   ~ 2500,
      median_income == 250001 ~ 250000,
      TRUE ~ median_income
    ),
    median_age = dplyr::na_if(median_age, 0),                     # one place reported a median age of 0

    # ---- Requested rounding: race/ethnicity percentages to 4 decimal places ----
    dplyr::across(c(pct_white, pct_black, pct_asian, pct_hispanic, pct_other_race), ~ round(.x, 4)),

    # ---- Types ----
    geography_level        = factor(geography_level, levels = c("place", "county")),
    place_type             = factor(place_type),
    state_abbr             = factor(state_abbr),
    county_match_status    = factor(county_match_status),
    median_income_censored = factor(median_income_censored),
    population             = as.integer(population),          # whole people
    county_count           = as.integer(county_count),
    multiple_counties      = as.logical(multiple_counties)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    geography_level, geoid, name, place_type, state_abbr,
    population, median_age, pct_male,
    pct_white, pct_black, pct_asian, pct_hispanic, pct_other_race,
    median_income, median_income_censored, poverty_rate, bachelors_or_higher,
    longitude, latitude, land_area_sqmi, population_density,
    county_geoid, county_name, county_count, multiple_counties, county_match_status
  )

# ---- Checks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Rows: ", nrow(census_clean), " (", paste(names(table(census_clean$geography_level)),
        table(census_clean$geography_level), collapse = ", "), ")")
message("Duplicate GEOIDs: ", sum(duplicated(census_clean[c("geography_level", "geoid")])))
message("Place names still containing a type, state, or parenthesis: ",
        sum(census_clean$geography_level == "place" &
              stringr::str_detect(census_clean$name, paste0(type_pattern, "|,|\\("))))
message("Race shares that don't sum to ~100: ",
        sum(abs(rowSums(dplyr::select(census_clean, pct_white:pct_other_race)) - 100) > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### Source 3

```{r}
# Reuse Source 1 objects so positions, schools and conferences match the roster exactly
if (!exists("clean_position") || !exists("fbs_rosters_clean")) {
  stop("Run the Source 1 cleaning chunk first: it defines clean_position() and fbs_rosters_clean.")
}
position_lookup["G"] = "Offensive Guard"                  # only CFBD code missing from the Source 1 lookup

id_cols   = c("season", "player_id", "school", "conference", "name", "position")
stat_cols = setdiff(names(cfbd_player_stats), id_cols)

# ---- School names: CFBD -> Source 1 roster names ----------------------------------
cfbd_school_map = c(
  "Florida Atlantic"      = "FAU",
  "Florida International" = "FIU",
  "Hawai'i"               = "Hawaii",
  "Massachusetts"         = "UMass",
  "Miami (OH)"            = "Miami University",
  "Northern Illinois"     = "NIU",
  "Pittsburgh"            = "Pitt",
  "San José State"        = "San Jose State",
  "South Florida"         = "USF",
  "UL Monroe"             = "ULM"
)

# Conference for each school, taken from the roster so both sources agree
roster_conference = fbs_rosters_clean |>
  dplyr::distinct(school, conference) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character))

# ---- Column names that state their units ------------------------------------------
rename_units = function(x) {
  x |>
    # Specific names first (clearer than the generic rule would give)
    stringr::str_replace("^passing_pct$",  "completion_percent") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_pct$",  "field_goal_percent") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_long$", "field_goal_longest_yards") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kickreturns_", "kick_returns_") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^puntreturns_", "punt_returns_") |>
    # Distances (yards)
    stringr::str_replace("_yds$",  "_yards") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_long$", "_longest_yards") |>
    # Rates (yards per event)
    stringr::str_replace("_ypa$", "_yards_per_attempt") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_ypc$", "_yards_per_carry") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_ypr$", "_yards_per_reception") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_ypp$", "_yards_per_punt") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_avg$", "_yards_per_return") |>
    # Counts
    stringr::str_replace("^passing_att$",       "passing_attempts") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^rushing_car$",       "rushing_carries") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^receiving_rec$",     "receptions") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^fumbles_fum$",       "fumbles") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^fumbles_rec$",       "fumbles_recovered") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^defensive_tot$",     "tackles_total") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^defensive_solo$",    "tackles_solo") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^defensive_tfl$",     "tackles_for_loss") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^defensive_sacks$",   "sacks") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^defensive_qb_hur$",  "qb_hurries") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^defensive_pd$",      "passes_defended") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^interceptions_int$", "interceptions") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_fgm$",       "field_goals_made") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_fga$",       "field_goals_attempted") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_xpm$",       "extra_points_made") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_xpa$",       "extra_points_attempted") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^kicking_pts$",       "kicking_points") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^punting_no$",        "punts") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^punting_in_20$",     "punts_inside_20") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^punting_tb$",        "punting_touchbacks") |>
    stringr::str_replace("^(kick|punt)_returns_no$", "\\1_returns") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_td$",  "_touchdowns") |>
    stringr::str_replace("_int$", "_interceptions")
}

# ---- Clean ----------------------------------------------------------------------
player_stats_clean = cfbd_player_stats |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Roster school names, then keep only the 139 schools in the Source 1 roster
    school = dplyr::coalesce(unname(cfbd_school_map[school]), school)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(school %in% roster_conference$school) |>
  dplyr::select(-conference) |>
  dplyr::left_join(roster_conference, by = "school") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Positions spelled out exactly like Source 1 ("WR" -> "Wide Receiver")
    position = clean_position(dplyr::na_if(stringr::str_squish(position), "?")),

    # Percentages: CFBD reports proportions (0.654) -> percent (65.4)
    dplyr::across(c(passing_pct, kicking_pct), ~ .x * 100),

    # Whole-number stats (yards, touchdowns, attempts) -> integer; stats with
    # fractions (half sacks/TFLs, rates, percentages) stay double
    dplyr::across(tidyselect::all_of(stat_cols),
                  ~ if (all(.x == round(.x), na.rm = TRUE)) as.integer(.x) else as.numeric(.x)),

    # Identifier types
    season     = as.integer(season),
    school     = factor(school, levels = levels(fbs_rosters_clean$school)),
    conference = factor(conference, levels = levels(fbs_rosters_clean$conference)),
    position   = factor(position)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(rename_units, tidyselect::all_of(stat_cols)) |>
  dplyr::relocate(season, player_id, school, conference, name, position) |>
  dplyr::arrange(conference, school, name)

# ---- Checks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Players: ", nrow(player_stats_clean), " | Schools: ", dplyr::n_distinct(player_stats_clean$school), " of ",
        nlevels(fbs_rosters_clean$school), " | Columns: ", ncol(player_stats_clean))
message("Roster schools with no CFBD stats: ",
        paste(setdiff(levels(fbs_rosters_clean$school), as.character(player_stats_clean$school)), collapse = ", "))
message("Duplicate player-seasons: ", sum(duplicated(player_stats_clean[c("season", "player_id")])))
message("Unrecognized positions: ", sum(is.na(player_stats_clean$position)))
message("Percent columns outside 0-100: ",
        sum(sapply(dplyr::select(player_stats_clean, tidyselect::ends_with("_percent")),
                   function(x) any(x < 0 | x > 100, na.rm = TRUE))))
```

## Save the cleaned data

Write to `../data/processed/`.

```{r}
processed_dir = "../data/processed"


write.csv(fbs_rosters_clean, 
          file.path(processed_dir, "fbs_rosters_clean.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(census_clean,
          file.path(processed_dir, "census_geography_2024_clean.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(player_stats_clean,
          file.path(processed_dir, "player_stats_clean.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
